newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end weaker, focus on S.Costa, PT.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end weaker, focus on S.Costa, PT.

text.p: Portuguese shares ended weaker, although they recovered from the lows of the day, with transactions in construction firm Soares da Costa and telecommunications 'blue chip' Portugal Telecom accounting for 70 percent of the total turnover of 16.8 billion escudos. Dealers said some investors were selling shares in order to raise cash for the forthcoming privatisation of state utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal. The transactions in 99.95 percent of the non-vote preference shares in Soares da Costa were probably linked to an internal reorganisation, dealers said. They said they expected investors to continue to take profits tomorrow. "The negative sentiment is set to continue. Tomorrow could be dominated by profit taking," a dealer said.
